title: definable-saturated
summary: A Lean 4 formalization of the relative consistency of ZFC + CH together with the following assertion. There is a countably saturated elementary extension of the natural-number arithmetic structure of cardinality aleph one; all such set-sized presentations are isomorphic; and no such presentation is ordinal definable. The class is defined without parameters. Removing CH from the asserted theory gives a consistent negative answer to MathOverflow question 382009 about definability up to isomorphism versus an ordinal-definable copy.
